tools.name: radar_scan
tools.description: One-shot continuous-monitoring scan of a Solana wallet for behavioral anomalies and risk score.

tools.name: radar_analyze
tools.description: Offline anomaly analysis and risk scoring over an array of enhanced Solana transactions without network calls.

tools.name: radar_selftest
tools.description: Offline smoke test verifying anomaly detection rules against a built-in transaction fixture.

HELIUS_API_KEY.description: Helius API key for Solana RPC and enhanced transaction history

SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Optional custom Solana RPC endpoint URL

RADAR_MAX_RISK.description: Maximum acceptable behavioral risk score threshold (0-100, default 30)

RADAR_MIN_LIQUIDITY_USD.description: Minimum acceptable wallet liquidity in USD (default 50)

RADAR_SEED_PAGES.description: Optional history page depth when seeding wallet baselines (1-20, default 3)

RADAR_QUIET_POLLS.description: Optional consecutive zero-tx polls before stretching poll interval (default 3)

RADAR_MAX_POLL_MS.description: Optional maximum stretched poll interval in milliseconds (default 3600000 = 60m)

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional webhook endpoint for real-time compact JSON anomaly alerts

RADAR_LLM_KEY.description: Optional API key for LLM-generated anomaly digests

RADAR_LLM_BASE.description: Optional LLM service base URL (defaults to OpenRouter or OpenAI)

RADAR_LLM_URL.description: Optional LLM service base URL alias (defaults to OpenRouter or local Ollama)

RADAR_LLM_MODEL.description: Optional LLM model identifier (e.g. meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct or gpt-4o-mini)

RADAR_LLM_PATH.description: Optional LLM API endpoint path (e.g. /api/generate for Ollama)

RADAR_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Optional timeout for LLM digest calls in milliseconds (default 5000)

RADAR_LLM_OPTIONS.description: Optional JSON string of model inference parameters forwarded in request body

radar_scan.description: Full scan with Helius transaction fetching, Jupiter USD pricing, and anomaly analysis

radar_analyze.description: Offline anomaly analysis over client-supplied transaction fixture

radar_selftest.description: Free offline health check and smoke test
